Tech Tinkerer.name: Tech Tinkerer
Tech Tinkerer.description:
🔩 You took apart every appliance in the house and put most of them back together, usually better.

🛠️ Tools feel natural in your hands.
🎯 Good for Support Course students and anyone who builds their own gear.

📈 Grants: Fabrication +5, Support Engineering +5
Tech Tinkerer.traitNarrativeEffects: The character spent high school building and repairing gadgets: radios, drones, bikes and anything with screws. They carry a small screwdriver everywhere and notice how a machine or a support item is put together.
